introduction: Georgia TANF combines qualifying-family cash assistance with an employment-services component. DFCS assesses the family and any participation requirements.
description: Georgia TANF combines qualifying-family cash assistance with an employment-services component. DFCS assesses the family and any participation requirements.

sections.who: The state describes TANF for eligible low-income families with children under 18, children aged 18 attending school full time, and pregnant applicants. Child-support cooperation is required unless good cause is established. Other eligibility rules also apply.
sections.get: Approved families receive monthly cash assistance. The case may include employment-related activities and support; follow the instructions for your own circumstances.
sections.docs:
• Prepare household income and financial information.
  • Have children’s relationship, age and school information available.
  • Keep records relevant to pregnancy, caregiving or a requested participation exception.
sections.apply:
1. Start with DFCS

    Use Georgia Gateway for TANF or obtain the paper application linked on the TANF page.

  2. Submit to the appropriate office

    For a paper application, follow the local DFCS submission instructions. Keep a copy and submission record.

  3. Complete the review

    Respond to requests about eligibility, child support and employment activities. Raise any concern about cooperation or participation with the caseworker.
sections.after: Check Gateway for status and notices. Read the decision alongside any employment-services instructions and reporting requirements.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Georgia TANF overview, Georgia Gateway program list. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is TANF only a cash payment?
Georgia describes an employment-services component as part of the program.
Can a pregnant applicant be considered?
The state includes pregnant applicants among the program groups, subject to eligibility checks.
What if child-support cooperation is a concern?
Tell DFCS about the circumstances. The state recognizes good cause as an exception, which the agency must assess.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
